material.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Apr 9 to Jul 29 (+47%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−5.3% to −12%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Oct 14 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−20%); a close over the wave-1 high (+18%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the February high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +16% in 13 sessions, then drifted for 4 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 48% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.
